Business RequirementGRN should be allowed as per mapped category in site.Solution As per current system functionality the category control on the site is only handle on the mentioned receipt type ASN (Advance Shipment Notice) from supplier- Against PO.We need to provide the same functionality on mentioned receipt type.Order Input Return
